description: This file contains C source code for handling WRG headers on MTD devices, including functions for fixing MD5 checksums and updating headers.

methods.name: wrg_fix_md5
methods.description: Fixes the MD5 checksum in the WRG header after recalculating it based on the data.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the WRG header on an MTD device at a specified offset, recalculating MD5 and rewriting the header.
